data.title: 苍崎青子 · 洋馆壁炉前的露肩毛衣小酌
data.description: 久远寺洋馆静谧的冬夜，壁炉中的柴火静静燃烧着，橙红的暖光驱散了山间寒意。青子换上了宽松柔软的浅驼色落肩毛衣，修长长腿盘坐在厚厚的波斯地毯上。她手端着高脚红酒杯，火光在她明艳的红发与光洁锁骨上跳跃。平日行事雷厉风行的第五魔法使，此刻目光温润如水，流露出极少示人的慵懒与柔情。
data.location: vintage European mansion parlor before a stone fireplace with Persian rug
data.action: sitting on Persian rug holding wine glass before fireplace, off-shoulder knit sweater revealing collarbone, firelight illuminating auburn hair, relaxed tender smile
data.lighting: warm dancing firelight and rich amber shadows in dark wooden parlor
data.mood: mature comfortable intimacy, mesmerizing magical hearth warmth
data.promptProse: Sitting gracefully on a plush rug before a stone fireplace in the Kuonji mansion, Aoko Aozaki wears an off-shoulder knit sweater. Warm firelight dances across her auburn hair and bare collarbones as she sips wine with fond, relaxed eyes.
data.animaCaption: Sitting on a rug by a mansion fireplace in an off-shoulder sweater, she holds a wine glass with relaxed affection.
